name: SLIM
intro: Konnichiwa! I'm SLIM, nicknamed the Moon Sniper.
Most landers aim for a zone kilometres wide. I aim for 100 metres!
My target: a small crater called Shioli, on a slope.
I don't need a long stay. Help me pick the spot.
briefing: Wait... one of my two main engines just fell off!
fact: SLIM landed within 55 m of its target... upside down! Its solar panel faced the wrong way, but it still worked.

alarm.title: Engine Nozzle Lost
alarm.alarm: ONE MAIN ENGINE LOST — THRUST UNBALANCED
alarm.briefing: One engine nozzle fell off during the descent! We're tilting! Choose where we land, precisely!
